_note: Private use only: IKEA 3D models from the product pages (rotera viewer). Do not publish or commit to a public repo. x, y = footprint centre in plan metres (DXF: x right, y up); rot_deg = world rotation.y = plan angle CCW; the model's front (+z in the GLB) faces plan angle rot_deg - 90. dims_mm = from the product page (w x d x h). A piece with "parent" is placed in that piece's local frame: "local" = [x, bottom height, z] in metres (glTF axes: x across, z = front direction), rot_deg relative to the parent. "kind": "bedding" is drawn parametrically (no IKEA model): duvet + 2 pillows sized from dims_mm. Optional "lift_m" raises a floor piece (the rug sits 2 mm up so it does not z-fight the floor plane). Optional "tilt_deg" rotates the model about its own x axis first (IKEA wall pictures are modelled lying flat). "kind": "books" draws a row of books (count, lean = indices of tipped books) on its parent shelf.
